stem.en: Sound reaches the end of the ear canal. Which list gives the parts in the order the vibration passes through them?

text.en: Cochlea, then tiny bones, then eardrum.
Tiny bones, then eardrum, then cochlea.
Eardrum, then cochlea, then tiny bones.
Eardrum, then tiny bones, then cochlea.

explanation.en: Sound first makes the eardrum, a thin membrane, vibrate. The tiny bones make these vibrations larger. The cochlea turns them into electrical signals, which travel to the brain.

hints.en: Which part is a thin membrane at the end of the ear canal?
Which part makes the electrical signals for the brain?
